$comment: The repositories whose beans the Platform board pulls in. Add or remove a repo here; nothing else needs to change. `store` is optional: leave it out and the script finds the store itself (a `cat/*/beans` branch if the repo has one, otherwise the folder named in the repo's `.beans.yml` on its default branch). `deny` lists repos that must never be pulled, whatever `sources` says.

sources.$note: Work runs off the litlfred fork for now (owner, 2026-10-20). When the fork is synced to WorldHealthOrganization/aai-platform, push the beans branch there first, then switch this entry to the WHO repo.

deny.why: Owner, 2026-10-20: not part of the Assured AI platform.
